description: Versioned historical legal-name alias table for 13 ETF targets where the manifest legal_name differs from the legal name used in the source statutory filing at the snapshot boundary date (2026-09-24). This authority is consumed by DOC_INDEX_V1_3_0 and SERIES_RESOLVER_V1_3_0 (via the alias-resolution path) to normalize resolution identity without mutating MANIFEST_V1.
resolution_rule: When resolving a target series, if the manifest legal_name is not found in the source document, the resolver MUST also check all historical_source_legal_names for this series_id before failing with SERIES_NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE. The alias lookup is keyed by series_id (primary) or class_id (fallback). No symbol-specific or CIK-specific overrides.
